\documentclass{amsart}
\usepackage{amsthm}
% BUG-31: \newcounter{other} is stripped by build_minimal_preamble.
% The subsequent \newtheorem{otherth}[other]{Theorem} uses counter 'other'
% as a shared counter, which requires the counter to exist first.
% The pipeline preserves the \newtheorem declarations (wrapped in \@ifundefined)
% but strips the \newcounter definition, causing "No counter 'other' defined".
\newtheorem{theor}{Theorem}[section]
\newcounter{other}
\renewcommand{\theother}{\Alph{other}}
\newtheorem{otherth}[other]{Theorem}
\newtheorem{otherp}[other]{Proposition}
\begin{document}
\section{Test}
\begin{theor}A main theorem.\end{theor}
\begin{otherth}A theorem from another paper.\end{otherth}
\begin{otherp}A proposition from another paper.\end{otherp}
\end{document}
